docs.purpose: During sign-up, shows a new user the admin-curated list of supplier names for the trade they chose, so they can pick their usual suppliers instead of typing them in.
docs.data_story: It reads 1 table — `trade_suppliers` and writes nothing. Its response is an explicit pick-by-name projection of 1 field, so a column added to a table upstream does not leak into the client by accident. It is called from 1 place: `mobile_onboarding_supplier`.
docs.under_126: Becomes a **CONTRACT descriptor** of archetype `QUERY`. It declares its `database.reads[]` with named columns, its response projection as an explicit whitelist, its auth class, its rate bucket and its staleness — and `outputs.writes` is forced to `"none"`. Its `consumers[]` becomes the edge list of the fan-out graph — the join nothing in this estate holds today.
